Etsy sellers, before you panic about the new AI image rules… READ THIS. 👇 Etsy is NOT banning AI-generated images or mockups across the board. But there are some important distinctions sellers need to understand. Here's what you need to know: ✨ AI-generated digital products are still permitted when they meet Etsy's Creativity Standards, including disclosure requirements. ✨ Print-on-demand sellers can still use qualifying mockups, but your images need to accurately represent the product your customer will receive. ✨ Handmade and physical product sellers have stricter photo requirements. Not every AI-generated lifestyle image is acceptable as a replacement for real product photography. #etsysellersoftiktok #etsysmallbusiness #printondemand #fyppp #etsymockups

If you sell print-on-demand products, digital products, or handmade products on Etsy, you NEED to understand trademark infringement before it puts your entire Etsy business at risk! October and November are two of the busiest months for Etsy sellers, and the LAST thing you want is to have your best-selling Etsy listings removed, your Etsy shop shut down, or face an Etsy permanent suspension because of trademark violations! I'm getting SO many messages from Etsy sellers right now dealing with Etsy listing removals and intellectual property infringement notices. And unfortunately, fixing a trademark violation isn't always as simple as deleting a word from your listing! After nearly 5 years of selling on Etsy, I cannot stress this enough: Learn how to conduct proper trademark searches, understand Etsy's intellectual property policies, and protect your Etsy shop! Even seemingly harmless words in your Etsy SEO, titles, tags, and product descriptions could create trademark issues.
